text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. During planning, the team should also define milestones—key points in time when progress is checked—and deliverables, the actual products or results to be completed. It is equally important to make sure everyone agrees on these goals. This is called stakeholder alignment, and it helps avoid confusion later. When all team members and stakeholders share the same understanding, the project is more likely to stay on track and finish successfully.
